description: This file manages user authentication in a SugarCRM-based CRM system. It handles login validation, session setup, audit trail logging, user privilege creation, and redirecting upon success or failure.

classes.name: Users
classes.description: Class representing user data and operations in the CRM system.

classes.name: LoginHistory
classes.description: Class handling user login history records.

methods.name: load_user
methods.description: Loads user details into the Users object using a provided password.

methods.name: is_authenticated
methods.description: Checks if the user's credentials are valid.

methods.name: user_login
methods.description: Records user login events, including IP and timestamp.
